name: Three-point interview / talking head
definition: Key, fill and back light on a seated or standing speaker.
how: Key 30-45 deg off camera axis, 15-30 deg above eye line, on the side the face turns toward (short side). Fill on the camera axis or opposite side, soft. Back/rim 120-160 deg behind, high, edging hair/shoulder. Background 1-2 stops under the face.
key_to_back_ratio: back ~ key level on dark hair, -1 stop on light hair
hardness: soft key, soft fill, harder back
purpose: Clear, flattering, separated from background.
avoid_when: glasses wearers if key is frontal and small (lens glare)
ai_image_prompt: talking-head portrait, soft key light from camera-left 35 degrees, gentle fill, thin warm rim light on hair, background one stop darker
ai_video_prompt: medium close-up interview, soft key from the left, subtle rim light, background stays darker, lighting constant
common_mistakes: fill equal to key (flat)
rim light so strong it glows
key from the camera side the face turns away from (broad, unflattering)
check: Waveform: face 55-75% IRE; background 1-2 stops lower; nose shadow stays on the shadow side.

name: High-key commercial
definition: Bright overall exposure, low contrast, few dark shadows.
how: Large soft key near the lens axis, strong fill or bounce, background lit to near white (+1 to +2 stops over the face). Clean white/pale set.
purpose: Optimism, cleanliness, clarity; product colours accurate.
use_when: bright Reels that must read in daylight
avoid_when: white products on white bg without edge definition

examples.note: animation stayed brighter than other genres while Hollywood films darkened overall

ai_image_prompt: high-key bright white studio, soft wraparound light, minimal shadows, clean commercial look
ai_video_prompt: bright high-key white set, soft even lighting, no harsh shadows, camera slowly orbits the product
common_mistakes: clipped whites losing frame/lens edges
no shadow at all -> objects float
check: Highlights < 100% IRE except speculars; product edge separation visible.

name: Low-key drama
definition: Mostly dark frame, one dominant source, deep shadows, high contrast.
how: Single key 60-90 deg to side, no or minimal fill (negative fill on shadow side), small rim to separate from black bg, background 3+ stops under.
purpose: Mystery, danger, moral ambiguity.
avoid_when: Reels watched outdoors on phones (lift mids in grade)

examples.note: recent films darkest near the 3/4 point then brighten through climax/epilogue

ai_image_prompt: low-key cinematic portrait, single hard side light from the right, deep black shadows, thin rim light separating hair from a black background
ai_video_prompt: dark room lit by one side light, deep shadows, the character turns into the light and her face is half revealed
common_mistakes: crushing the eyes into black with no catchlight
noise in shadows after lifting in post
check: Eyes or at least one eye readable; blacks ~0-5% IRE but detail where story needs it.

name: Chiaroscuro single source
definition: Strong light-dark modelling from one directional source, painterly.
how: One medium-soft source high and to the side (45-70 deg az, 30-45 deg el), flag spill off background, let shadow side fall off naturally; optional faint bounce.
key_to_back_ratio: no back light; separation by background tone
purpose: Sculpted, classical, intimate gravity.
ai_image_prompt: chiaroscuro portrait lit by a single window-sized light high on the left, painterly falloff into dark shadow, Rembrandt triangle on the cheek
ai_video_prompt: single soft side light from a high window, deep chiaroscuro falloff, slow push-in on the craftsman's hands
common_mistakes: adding fill until it becomes flat
check: Value plan: 3 values max (light, half-tone, shadow).

name: Motivated window key (day interior)
definition: Key appears to come from a visible or implied window; fill from room bounce.
how: Large soft source outside/at the window (diffusion frame); subject 45-90 deg to window; white card or wall bounce for fill; shoot toward the shadow side for depth.
key_to_back_ratio: window itself +2-3 stops over face (allowed to bloom)
purpose: Naturalism with direction.
avoid_when: the set has no window logic (light direction would be unmotivated)

examples.note: natural light removed and re-created so a 12-hour day matched; pastel light motivated by window blinds

ai_image_prompt: soft daylight from a large window on the right, gentle falloff across the room, subtle bounce fill, natural interior
ai_video_prompt: daylight from the window on the right stays constant while she walks across the room into the shadow side
common_mistakes: window light direction flips between shots
window clipped with no detail and nothing else bright
check: Every shot of the scene: key side = window side.

name: Practicals as key (night interior)
definition: Visible lamps/candles/screens in frame are (or appear to be) the key light.
how: Choose practicals as the design; boost them (higher-watt bulbs, dimmers); hide a small soft source near the practical on the same line; let practicals bloom. Ambient 1-2 stops below with cool fill (moon/street) for contrast.
key_to_back_ratio: practical bulb itself 2-3 stops over face

kelvin.ambient: cool fill 5600-7000 (quarter-to-half blue on HMI per Spinotti)

purpose: Believable night, warm pockets in dark space.
use_when: ร้านแว่นตีสอง / night shop
avoid_when: the practical is not in the frame or implied (unmotivated warm patch)

examples.note: practicals 'were quite often our key lights'; halos and burn-outs wanted
restaurant lit by practical candles with only background practicals

ai_image_prompt: night interior lit only by a warm desk lamp in frame, face lit from the lamp side, cool blue moonlight from the window as fill, warm pools of light in darkness
ai_video_prompt: night shop interior, warm practical lamps are the only key light, cool moonlight through the window, steady lighting as the optician walks between the lamps
common_mistakes: face lit from a side with no lamp
lamp shade clipped so the practical looks fake
warm/cool mix with no logic
check: Point at every bright patch and name its source in frame.

name: Top light, eyes in shadow
definition: Overhead diffused source leaves eye sockets dark.
how: Overhead soft box or ceiling fixture directly above or slightly in front; no eye-level fill; let the brow cast shadow; optional tiny eye light only when the eyes must read.
purpose: Withhold the inner life of a character; power and menace.
avoid_when: you need empathy or lip-reading clarity

examples.note: Willis on overhead diffusion and darkness around Pacino 'because of what the character was'; 'sometimes it's better not to see what is going on until a given point'

ai_image_prompt: man seated under a single overhead light, eyes in deep shadow beneath the brow, dark room, tense
ai_video_prompt: overhead light only, the man's eyes stay in shadow until he leans forward into the light
common_mistakes: using it for every character (loses meaning)
AI adds random eye catchlights
check: Eyes readable only at the intended beat.

name: Rim/edge separation on dark background
definition: Back light from behind-above outlines hair, shoulders or product edges against a dark background.
how: Hard or strip light 120-170 deg behind the subject, 30-60 deg above; flag lens flare; key subtle. For glasses: two strip lights behind-sides draw the frame outline.
lit_to_shadow_ratio: key 2:1-4:1; rim +0.5-1 stop over key on dark subjects
purpose: Shape and depth separation (figure/ground) without lifting the background.
avoid_when: flat cartoon style unless drawn as a rim shape
ai_image_prompt: black eyeglasses on a dark background outlined by thin bright rim lights on both edges, subtle front fill
ai_video_prompt: dark background, the camera orbits the glasses slowly while a thin rim light traces the frame edges
common_mistakes: rim spills on the cheek/nose
lens flare from an unflagged back light
check: Edge visible on a phone at 50% brightness.

name: Silhouette (backlit)
definition: Subject darker than a bright background; shape only.
how: Expose for the background (sky/window/screen) and leave the subject 3+ stops under; strong recognisable profile; no front fill.
purpose: Anonymity, iconic shape, mystery; universal 'everyone' character.
ai_image_prompt: silhouette of a person in profile against a bright orange sunset sky, figure completely dark, clean recognisable shape
ai_video_prompt: backlit silhouette walks slowly across a bright window, the figure stays fully dark
common_mistakes: profile overlaps other shapes (unreadable)
AI adds fill light on the face
check: Fill the figure solid black: still recognisable?

name: Bounce fill (natural)
definition: Fill created by reflecting the key or sun off a card, wall, floor or sand.
how: White/silver/gold reflector 1-2 m from subject on the shadow side; or let a light floor/sand bounce upward (watch for under-light look). Bounce surface becomes the source.
purpose: Open shadows without a second visible source.
ai_image_prompt: sunlit portrait with soft warm bounce light filling the shadow side, natural look
ai_video_prompt: bright sun from behind, soft bounce light from the sand fills her face evenly
common_mistakes: gold bounce on a cool scene (colour mismatch)
bounce from below reading as horror
check: Fill colour matches the scene logic; shadow side still darker.

name: Negative fill
definition: Black flags/surfaces near the shadow side to absorb bounce and increase contrast.
how: Black floppy/solid 0.5-1 m from the face on the shadow side; removes ambient bounce in bright rooms or overcast exteriors.
purpose: Shape on flat days; drama without adding light.
ai_image_prompt: overcast daylight portrait with strong modelling, shadow side deepened, sculpted cheekbones
common_mistakes: flag visible in a wide
contrast so high the eye on the shadow side dies
check: Shadow eye still has a catchlight or detail.

name: Golden-hour backlight
definition: Low warm sun behind/side of the subject; warm rim and flare, soft fill from sky.
how: Sun 120-170 deg behind, elevation < 15 deg; expose for face with bounce or let it fall 1 stop under; flare controlled by angle.
key_to_back_ratio: rim sun much brighter than face
purpose: Nostalgia, romance, warmth; natural warm/cool split.
avoid_when: continuity over a long shoot (light changes every minute)
ai_image_prompt: golden hour backlight, low warm sun behind her shoulder, glowing hair rim, soft cool sky fill on the face, gentle lens flare
ai_video_prompt: golden hour, low sun behind the subject, warm rim on hair, gentle flare as the camera arcs slowly
common_mistakes: sun direction changes across shots
flare washes out the product
check: Sun side consistent across every shot of the scene.

name: Overcast continuity lighting
definition: Soft sky as the single source, chosen for shot-to-shot match.
how: Shoot when cloud cover is stable; add negative fill for shape; avoid sun breaks mid-sequence; for AI generation lock the phrase 'overcast soft daylight, no direct sun' in every prompt.
purpose: Even, matchable light across many shots or a long take.
use_when: many AI shots that must cut together

examples.note: rehearsed in sun, shot under cloud cover so the one-shot dailies stayed even

ai_image_prompt: overcast soft daylight, no direct sun, diffuse shadows, muted natural colours
ai_video_prompt: overcast soft daylight, no direct sunlight, consistent diffuse light throughout the shot
common_mistakes: one shot with sun among overcast shots
flat image with no negative fill
check: Line up all shot thumbnails: brightness/temperature within ~1/3 stop and ~200K.

name: Moonlight / day-for-night
definition: Cool, low-level, directional light reading as moonlight; or daylight footage graded to night.
how: Live: one large cool soft/hard source high and to the side, 2-3 stops under normal; warm practicals for contrast. Post: underexpose 1.5-2 stops, desaturate, shift cool, keep sky darker than subject (shoot away from sky).
purpose: Readable night.
use_when: night exteriors, horror, night optic shop exterior
avoid_when: bright sky in frame for day-for-night
ai_image_prompt: moonlit night exterior, cool blue directional light from high right, deep shadows, warm window glow in the background
ai_video_prompt: night, cool moonlight from the right, dark blue shadows, a warm window light glows behind the walking figure
common_mistakes: blue everywhere with no warm reference
day-for-night with bright sky
check: Is there one warm reference so the blue reads as night, not a white-balance error?

name: Screen glow face light
definition: Phone/laptop screen as the only key on a face in the dark.
how: Small soft source low and in front (screen position), cool 6500-8000K, flicker-free; slight colour shifts as content changes.
purpose: Modern isolation, late-night scrolling, eye-strain stories.
ai_image_prompt: dark bedroom, face lit only by the cool glow of a phone screen from below, eyes reflecting the screen
ai_video_prompt: dark room, the cool phone light on her face shifts slightly as she scrolls
common_mistakes: light from above although the screen is below
check: Light direction matches screen position.

name: Candle/firelight with flicker
definition: Warm, low, flickering key from flame sources.
how: Real candles plus hidden warm source on a flicker dimmer (irregular 0.5-3 Hz, small amplitude); 1800-2000K look; in HTML animate brightness +/-5-10% with noise, not a sine.
purpose: Intimacy, ritual, period feel, danger.

examples.note: burning church: flames as main source plus flares, 360 deg dimmer-controlled rig

ai_image_prompt: face lit by warm candlelight from below-front, flickering soft orange glow, dark surroundings
ai_video_prompt: warm candlelight gently flickers on her face, shadows move subtly
common_mistakes: regular, metronomic flicker
AI video flicker on the whole frame (brightness pumping)
check: Flicker only on surfaces lit by the flame.

name: Under-light (unease)
definition: Key from below the face.
how: Source below chin level aimed up; no counter top light.
purpose: Make a face feel wrong/uncanny.
avoid_when: any sympathetic or product beauty shot
ai_image_prompt: face lit from directly below, shadows cast upward over the eyes, eerie horror lighting
common_mistakes: accidental under-light from bright floor/sand bounce in normal scenes
check: Is unease intended? If not, kill the floor bounce.

name: Eyewear on face: glare-free key
definition: Portrait key placed so lens reflections miss the camera.
how: Key high (40-60 deg el) and wide (45+ deg az) so the reflection angle leaves the lens path; large source close; tilt the frames' temples up slightly; check AR coating residual colour.
purpose: Eyes visible through lenses; frame shape clear.
ai_image_prompt: portrait wearing clear eyeglasses, soft key light high and to the side, no glare on the lenses, eyes clearly visible
ai_video_prompt: she turns her head slowly, lenses stay free of glare, eyes visible through the glasses
common_mistakes: frontal ring light (double ring reflection)
glare appears as she turns
check: Scrub the whole move: any frame with lens glare covering a pupil = fail.

name: Neon split colour (dual-gel)
definition: Two coloured sources from opposite sides (e.g., magenta and cyan), often motivated by signs.
how: Two sources 90-120 deg apart, complementary gels or RGB LEDs, low ambient; skin in the overlap stays near neutral; signs in frame motivate.
purpose: Night-city energy, stylised modernity.
avoid_when: product colour must be accurate (frames' true colour shifts)
ai_image_prompt: night city portrait, cyan neon light from the left, magenta neon from the right, dark background with blurred signs
ai_video_prompt: neon cyan and magenta light from opposite sides, signs flicker softly behind as he walks
common_mistakes: saturated skin clipping in one channel
product colour misrepresented in an ad
check: RGB parade: no single channel clipped on skin.

name: 2D cel: one key, one shadow tone
definition: Cartoon lighting with a single direction encoded as one hard shadow shape and optional rim.
how: Decide key direction per scene (write it in the shot list), paint one shadow tone (multiply 20-35%), optional rim on the key-opposite side for night; keep it identical across shots.
purpose: Readable form and continuity in 2D/rig animation.
ai_image_prompt: flat cel-shaded cartoon, single light from upper left, one hard shadow tone on the right side of every object
ai_video_prompt: cel-shaded cartoon, consistent light from upper left, shadows stay on the right as characters move
common_mistakes: shadow sides differ between characters in one scene
check: Every object's shadow on the same side.
